<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the signals at 138.76, 131.45 (two signals), 130.59 (two signals), and 121.30 ppm fall within the typical aromatic carbon region (≈110–160 ppm). That accounts for 6 distinct aromatic carbon signals. The remaining signals (43.47 and 38.60 ppm) are aliphatic. Therefore, the compound contains 6 aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
